name: Guardian
description: A Guardian, the six-legged ancient machine from The Legend of Zelda, in 183 pieces, 26 cm across its legs and 14 cm tall: a domed stone body ringed with pink lights, a head with one blue eye, and six ball-jointed legs you can pose. It stands on a short black stand.

steps.caption: The stand: four black round 2 x 2 bricks, stacked. It carries the body, so the legs only have to hold their pose
The body starts with a black round 8 x 8 plate. Under its middle goes a pink round 4 x 4 plate: the glow underneath, and where the stand goes
A black round 4 x 4 brick in the middle: the core
A socket: a black 1 x 2 plate, the plate with a socket on its side, and a black 1 x 2 plate on top. Make six
Two sockets at the front of the rim, sockets to the front
One in the middle of each side, socket out
Two at the back, sockets to the back
Pink round 1 x 1 bricks on the free studs round the edge: the lights. Two at the front and two at the back
And two each side, either side of the middle socket
The second black round 8 x 8 plate on top of them all
The dome: four quarter domes, their studs together in the middle
Round the dome, on the rim: a tan 1 x 2 slope in the middle of each side, sloping outwards
A pink round tile on each of the four corner studs between them
On the dome's four studs a dark tan round 4 x 4 plate, with four tan quarter-ring tiles round its edge: the ring on top of the dome
The neck, in the middle of the ring: a pink round 2 x 2 plate and a round 2 x 2 brick
Press the body onto the stand, by the middle of the pink plate underneath
A leg: the first link, a plate with a ball at one end and a socket at the other. On it a black 1 x 2 plate, and on that a white curved slope, its thick end at the ball. Make six legs
Snap the second link's ball into the first one's socket, bent up, and cover it the same way
The third link, level: the top of the arch
The fourth link, bent down
The fifth link, bent down further
The foot: a plate with a ball at one end only, pointing down. On its far stud a plate with a tooth, the tooth past the end: the claw. A cheese slope behind it
Snap the first leg's ball into a front socket, the leg pointing straight out from the middle of the body
The other front leg
A leg in the middle of each side: the right one
And the left one
A back leg
The sixth leg. Bend the legs until all six claws rest on the table
The head: a round 4 x 4 plate, and on it the round brick with a hole in each side
Push a half pin into each of the four holes, stud out
The eye, on the front pin: a pink round plate with one stud, and the clear blue round tile on it
A clear pink round tile on each of the other three pins
A tan round plate, and the plain round brick: the top of the head
A round plate on top. In its middle a round plate with one stud and a cone: the spike
The two horns: a brick with a stud on its side at each side of the top, stud to the front
A pink round tile on each of those studs, and a pink cheese slope on top of each brick, sloping outwards
Press the head onto the neck, the eye to the front
